grounding.card_text:
Name: Ada 'Wren' Voss, 34, Female, body type Thin.
Childhood: Urbworld lab brat. Grew up in the lower levels of a research arcology, taking apart discarded instruments and teaching herself from salvaged data slates. Her parents rarely noticed.
Adulthood: Field researcher. Spent a decade cataloguing ruined sites for a university guild, trading comfort for answers. The work taught her patience and to distrust easy conclusions.
Traits: Too Smart (Learns quickly but forgets to eat, and is bothered by tedious company.); Sanguine (Almost always in a cheerful mood.)
Skills (* minor passion, ** major passion): Intellectual 15**, Medicine 9*
Ideoligion: Seekers of the Quiet Light. Memes: rationalist (Reason is the highest virtue.); structure (Order and hierarchy keep people safe.). Precepts: Drugs: prohibited; Meat eating: abhorrent; Rituals: rarely; Slavery: horrible.
Xenotype: Baseliner (Baseliners are normal humans with no engineered genes.)
Genes: quick study, dark hair
Noble title: Knight
Joined the colony: Crash-landed with two companions and a cracked data slate.
Notable moments: Cured the colony of a plague; Survived a raid alone; Wrote the first colony ledger
Appearance: Short dark hair, pale skin, wears a lab coat and goggles.
